name: editor_tools
label: Editor Tools
description: Measuring tools for the Edit timeline: analyze a clip (onsets, tempo, key, peak/RMS), detect its tempo, compare MIDI note starts against audio onsets to get the offset to nudge by, and time-stretch audio to a ratio or a tempo without moving its pitch (ffmpeg atempo chain). Reuses the rhythm engine for tempo and the analysis module's Krumhansl key detection; no model.
